verdict.rationale: Together AI's own docs show a first-party CLI (`tg`) in use across several workflows: batch submission, dedicated-endpoint deployment, and launching fine-tuning jobs. However, the evidence is scattered command snippets rather than dedicated CLI documentation, and endpoint commands sit under a `beta` namespace, so the depth of the CLI is unproven. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI install/reference page, evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output), non-beta coverage of endpoint management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can launch a fine-tuning job from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI
tg beta endpoints deploy google/gemma-4-E4B-it --endpoint my-endpoint
